verdict.rationale: Unity's own docs say its WebGL target publishes real-time interactive 3D graphics to the browser, which covers the 'WebGL today' part of the story. Multi-platform build profiles back this up. But the pack has nothing on build payload size or optimization, and nothing on WebGPU. missing for 10: evidence of reasonable/optimized web payload size, any WebGPU backend or roadmap, independent or hands-on corroboration of browser export quality.
